name: Goblin
description: A sneaky, cackling raider with a rusty knife and a talent for ambush.
tactics: Hides first, then jumps the weakest looking player. Flees at half health.

name: Orc Warrior
description: A scarred brute in mismatched armor who loves a straight fight.
tactics: Charges the biggest threat. Gets in the way of its friends.

name: Ogre
description: A lumbering giant with a club made from a small tree.
tactics: Swings at whoever is closest. Easy to trick, hard to survive.

name: Cave Troll
description: A hulking, warty monster whose wounds close faster than they open.

powers.name: Regenerate
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6. Fire or acid in the same turn stops it.

tactics: Fights until hurt, regenerates, fights again. Best solved with fire.

name: Chrome Trooper
description: A white-armored soldier in a faceless helmet, bought by the thousand and trained to shoot just past you.
tactics: Arrives in squads of four or more. Rolls disadvantage on attacks beyond one pencil length.

name: Fuzz Warrior
description: A knee-high, fuzzy forest dweller with a spear, a drum and fearsome traps.
tactics: Fights from the treetops. Always has a net, a log or a boulder ready for something big.

name: Mask Hunter
description: A lone figure in battered armor and a mask, with a jetpack, a wrist rocket and a contract.
skillNote: Jetpack lets it fly for 15 minutes or one battle.

powers.name: Wrist Rockets
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

tactics: Captures if paid to. Escapes by jetpack when losing.

name: Dusk Monk
description: A hooded warrior in black robes with a humming blade of colored light and a magnetic grip on the world.

powers.name: Mind Grip
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Telekinetic choke or push.

powers.name: Blade Deflect
powers.text: No damage. Turns the first blaster shot at it back at the shooter.

tactics: Lets the troopers soften you up, then walks into the fight. Wants to recruit the strongest player.

name: Grandpa Giant
description: A towering, bearded giant who bakes pies the size of wagon wheels and apologizes when he steps on things.
tactics: Rather bake than brawl. Might join the party if offered a good pie.

name: Dread Lord
description: A towering figure in black armor with a breath mask, a crimson blade and an army that fears him more than the enemy.

powers.name: Choke Grip
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is lifted and cannot move.

tactics: Lets underlings fail. Always offers the strongest player a place at his side.

name: Laser Grunt
description: A helmeted foot soldier in flak armor, one of ten billion, sent forward in waves on the Emperor's say-so.
tactics: Always arrives in numbers of 5 or more. Surrenders only if an officer is dead.

name: Star Templar
description: A seven-foot, genetically-engineered warrior in sealed power armor, sworn to a distant emperor and a brotherhood banner.

powers.name: Bolt Salvo
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Explosive bolt-shells.

tactics: Fights in squads of five. Drops from orbit in a pod when the shooting starts.

name: Iron Marshal
description: A black-coated officer with a peaked cap and a pistol who shoots cowards before the enemy does.

powers.name: Summary Execution
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. May target one of its own allies; if it does, allies in sight have advantage on their next roll.

tactics: Keeps the troops in line. Always positioned behind someone else.

name: Scrapjaw Brawler
description: A green, tusked bruiser in welded scrap armor with a shoota that jams and a big choppa that never does.

powers.name: Mob Rush
powers.text: No damage. All allies in sight roll their next attack with advantage.

tactics: Charges in a mob. Fights better the more of his mates are around.

name: Ruin Knight
description: A scarred, spiked, horned warrior in corrupted power armor, who fought for the Emperor ten thousand years ago.

powers.name: Warp Bolt
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A sizzling bolt of sorcerous warp energy.

tactics: Leads cultists and daemons. Offers the party a place in the dark if it gets the chance.

name: Silver Seer
description: A tall, graceful elf in runed, smooth armor who has already seen how this fight ends.

powers.name: Mind Lance
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A bolt of focused psychic force.

powers.name: Foresight
powers.text: No damage. Once per rest, makes any roll it just failed again.

tactics: Fights from range. Hates being rushed.

name: Sky Coalition Warrior
description: A short, blue-skinned soldier in sleek armor who speaks of the greater good and shoots from behind a drone.
tactics: Shoots from a distance and talks about peace afterward. Fights alongside a drone.

name: Gear Priest
description: A red-robed priest of the Machine God with a mechanical arm, a third eye and a litany to the toaster.

powers.name: Machine Rite
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a construct or machine, itself included.

tactics: Fights beside constructs and servitors. Offers a trade for rare machines.

name: Witch Hunter
description: A grim, armored investigator with a flamer, a sealed warrant and the legal right to burn a whole planet.

powers.name: Purging Flame
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Fire that does not go out.

tactics: Questions first, burns second. Has authority to commandeer anything or anyone.

name: Suit Guard
description: A mirror-shaded security officer in a tailored suit who works for whoever signs the paychecks.
tactics: Calls for backup first. Has orders not to damage the building.

name: Street Razor
description: A neon-lit mercenary with mantis blades, chrome reflexes and a debt to the wrong people.

powers.name: Mono-Wire Sweep
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A monomolecular filament that slices through armor.

tactics: Strikes first. Fights better in tight alleys than in the open.

name: Wire Jockey
description: A hunched hacker with a datajack, a laptop on their knees and a smile like a keyboard.

powers.name: Trace Burn
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Fries a machine or a person's implants through the wire.

tactics: Stays in the back with a laptop. Can unlock doors, disable turrets and turn off cameras.

name: Chop-Shop Doc
description: A one-eyed, tattooed surgeon who will install anything for cash, no questions, and warranty void if you ask.

powers.name: Emergency Patch
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally, and can install a minor cyber-implant for the price of 1 bag.

tactics: Prefers to bargain, then stitch. Defends their clinic with security drones.

name: Chrome Psycho
description: A twitching, half-metal wreck of a person, drowned in implants and just barely conscious.

powers.name: Overclock
powers.text: No damage. Takes a bonus turn this round, then takes d6 damage.

tactics: Does not retreat. Rampages until restrained or unplugged.

name: Quickdraw Outlaw
description: A hat-wearing, spur-jingling stranger with two revolvers and a reputation to protect.

powers.name: Fan the Hammer
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Six shots in two heartbeats.

tactics: Calls a duel. Shoots first and apologizes never.

name: Bandit Chief
description: A dust-coated, gold-toothed leader with a gang of ruffians, a fast horse and a train to rob.

powers.name: Hired Guns
powers.text: No damage. Calls in two Quickdraw Outlaws (0.25 difficulty each, roll as bandits).

tactics: Never fights without a gang. Flees on a fast horse if wounded.

name: Robed Cultist
description: A sallow, hooded figure with a ritual knife and a wide, unfocused smile.
tactics: Fights in a mob and chants. A dead cultist leaves a note that reads 'THE STARS ARE RIGHT'.

name: Cult Magister
description: A bald, tattooed leader with hollow eyes who reads from a book that bleeds.

powers.name: Terrible Chant
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Players hearing the chant are frightened (disadvantage) until they rest.

tactics: Starts a ritual and tries to finish it. Stopping the ritual halves its power.

name: Befuddled Wizard
description: A pointy-hatted, bearded wizard who has lost his glasses, his staff and the name of the spell he's casting.

powers.name: Wild Spell
powers.text: No damage. Casts a spell with a random effect: the GM rolls a d6 (1: turns into a frog, 6: it works perfectly).

tactics: Casts spells and misses. Wanders off if distracted by a shiny object.

name: Roaming Minstrel
description: A feather-hatted traveling singer with a lute, a bag of gossip and a song for every occasion.

powers.name: Heartening Ballad
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to any ally in earshot.

tactics: Avoids a fight by singing. Flees if the audience gets angry.

name: Cave Dwarf
description: A short, thick-bearded miner with a pickaxe, a bad attitude and a lantern that never goes out.
tactics: Fights in tunnels. Never leaves a gem behind.

name: Braggart Knight
description: A shining, plumed knight who has never lost a duel, according to him.
tactics: Challenges the strongest player to a joust. Cries foul if he loses.

name: Errant Knight
description: A battered, honest knight on a quest for a grail, a lost love or just a decent meal.
tactics: Fights fairly and honors a surrender. Joins the party for a worthy cause.

name: Greenwood Archer
description: A hooded forest hunter with a longbow, a green cloak and a reputation for stealing from the rich.

powers.name: Arrow Volley
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Arrows rain from the canopy.

tactics: Fires from the trees and moves. Never fights in the open.

name: Castle Guard
description: A helmeted soldier in a tabard, a spear and a bad feeling about the night shift.
tactics: Sounds the alarm when outnumbered. Takes bribes if offered quietly.

name: Cutpurse
description: A hooded, quick-fingered street thief who has already lifted your purse and your good mood.
tactics: Steals and runs. A player who catches the thief gets the loot back.

name: Temple Healer
description: A robed, soft-spoken healer who keeps bandages in one pocket and a mace in the other.

powers.name: Healing Touch
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally, itself included.

tactics: Heals the wounded, friend or foe. Dislikes fighting.

name: Black Knight
description: A knight in black armor and a closed visor who blocks a bridge and challenges all comers.
tactics: Holds a bridge or ford. Never reveals his face. Fights to the death if challenged.

name: Scheming Chancellor
description: A smiling, slender royal advisor with ink-stained fingers and a cup of wine for everyone.

powers.name: Poisoned Cup
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

tactics: Never fights directly. Always has a guard nearby and a plan to blame someone else.

name: Sellsword Captain
description: A scarred, tired veteran who leads a company of hired blades and fights for whoever pays best.
tactics: Will switch sides if offered more than he is being paid. Keeps his word once hired.

name: Hexmaster
description: A gaunt, black-robed sorcerer whose shadow moves a half-second too late.

powers.name: Dark Bolt
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A bolt of cold, black fire.

powers.name: Hex
powers.text: No damage. Curses a target: disadvantage on one skill until it rests or the hexmaster dies.

tactics: Casts from the back of the room. Teleports away in a puff of black smoke when wounded.

name: Dusk Enchantress
description: A beautiful, soft-voiced sorceress in a gown of shadows who whispers promises that always have a catch.

powers.name: Enthrall
powers.text: No damage. A player who hears her voice must win a Charm challenge or follow her commands until they rest.

powers.name: Shadow Veil
powers.text: No damage. She and her allies become invisible to normal sight until they attack.

tactics: Seduces and manipulates. Never fights alone; attacks only when cornered.

name: Hooded Headsman
description: A masked, broad-shouldered executioner with a huge axe and an unnerving professional calm.

powers.name: Final Stroke
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Brings the axe down on a bound or fallen target.

tactics: Appears at a trial or a dungeon. Never speaks. Does not stop.

name: Iron Warlord
description: A scar-faced conqueror in iron armor with a war band of thousands and not a hint of mercy.

powers.name: War Cry
powers.text: No damage. All allies within sight gain advantage on their next attack.

tactics: Leads from the front. Takes prisoners to ransom or sacrifice.

name: Neon Busker
description: An LED-covered street performer with a glowing guitar and a thousand followers on the feed.
tactics: Performs for a crowd. Avoids fights and live-streams them instead.

name: Gig Courier
description: A hoverboard-riding delivery runner with a backpack of questionable parcels and no time for you.
tactics: Runs away from fights. Always has a package that is somehow worth a fortune.

name: Organ Broker
description: A smiling, immaculate dealer with a cooler, a scalpel and a long list of customers.

powers.name: Surgical Strike
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Aimed at a gap in armor or an implant.

tactics: Takes people alive and unharmed (mostly). Has a van and two thugs outside.

name: Megacorp Chairman
description: A pale, immaculate billionaire with a hundred floors, a thousand lawyers and an opinion about everything.

powers.name: Kill Order
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Orbital strike, drone swarm or sniper team.

powers.name: Golden Parachute
powers.text: No damage. Escapes through a hidden exit, a helicopter or a lawyer-filed injunction.

tactics: Never in the room when the fight starts. Offers the party a job at triple pay.

name: Doomsday Preacher
description: A hollow-eyed revival preacher with a battered Bible, a cough and a very specific end date.

powers.name: Hellfire Sermon
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Listeners are shaken by guilt and dread.

tactics: Preaches until he is stopped. Followers do the fighting.

name: Saloon Brawler
description: A bearded, hat-less drunk who got thrown out of three saloons this week and has his eye on your hat.
tactics: Starts a fight over nothing. Passes out in the middle of it.

name: Scrap Gremlin
description: A knee-high, giggling, green runt with a wrench who 'fixes' things by hitting them.
tactics: Hides behind bigger ones. Runs when scared and returns when not.

name: Eager Cultist
description: A cheerful new cultist in an oversized robe with a clipboard, a nametag and a lot of enthusiasm.
tactics: Asks if you've heard the good news. Bursts into tears if it is attacked.

name: Curio Dealer
description: A quiet, bespectacled shopkeeper with a cluttered store, a wooden box and a suspiciously good price for you.

powers.name: Cursed Trade
powers.text: No damage. Sells a mysterious item that has advantage once per rest, but the buyer is cursed (GM's choice) when it is used.

tactics: Never fights. Warns of the item's price and names a price anyway.

name: Sand Raider
description: A masked, robed desert nomad with a hooked staff, a rifle and a strong dislike for strangers.
tactics: Ambushes from the dunes in a group. Disappears if the odds turn.

name: Cantina Smuggler
description: A smirking, vest-wearing pilot with a fast ship, a faster mouth and a very big debt.

powers.name: Shoot First
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Takes a surprise shot before anyone else acts.

tactics: Bluffs first, shoots second. Runs for the ship if things turn bad.

name: Arena Champion
description: A scarred, undefeated pit fighter in armor made from the trophies of a hundred matches.
tactics: Fights for glory. Respects a good opponent and can be bargained with.

name: Rogue Star Ace
description: A cocky, orange-jumpsuited fighter pilot with a fast ship and a lot of kills.

powers.name: Barrel Roll
powers.text: No damage. Dodges the next attack aimed at it or its ship.

tactics: Fights from the cockpit. On foot, it runs for the ship.

name: Toll Troll
description: A lumpy, moss-bearded troll with a fancy hat, a ledger and a bridge that nobody crosses for free.
tactics: Insists on the toll. Will accept riddles, jokes or a nice sandwich in place of coin.

name: Hollow Thrall
description: A pale, glassy-eyed servant who stumbles forward, mutters a name and never blinks.
tactics: Walks forward. Stops if its master is slain or the control is broken.

name: Legendary Champion
description: A scarred, cloaked hero with a ballad about every scar and a sword that has slain things that don't exist anymore.

powers.name: Mighty Blow
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. A blow that dents mountains.

tactics: Fights fairly and can be talked down. Follows a code of honor and will not fight the helpless.

name: Frost King
description: A fifteen-foot, ice-bearded giant on a throne of glaciers who rules a hall of frost and a feast that never ends.

powers.name: Blizzard
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Players hit have halved movement until they warm up.

tactics: Welcomes guests with a feast that is also a trap. Demands a tribute or a challenge.

name: Deckhand Scallywag
description: A barefoot, gap-toothed sailor with a mop, a cutlass and a lot of opinions about the cook.
tactics: Fights in a gang. Drops its weapon to eat if food is offered.

name: Press Ganger
description: A burly dockside thug with a club, a bag and a very friendly offer of a drink.
tactics: Offers a drink in a tavern, then clubs the sleepers. Drags victims to a ship.

name: Cutlass Corsair
description: A coat-tailed, rope-swinging swashbuckler with a cutlass, a pistol and a jaunty red sash.
tactics: Swings on ropes and chandeliers. Surrenders if its ship is lost.

name: Navy Lieutenant
description: A crisp, blue-coated naval officer with a sword, a spyglass and an utterly unshakable faith in regulations.

powers.name: Fire the Cannons
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. A broadside from a nearby ship.

tactics: Barks orders and calls in the ship's guns. Honors a flag of truce.

name: Pirate Captain
description: A bellowing, bearded captain with three pistols, a peg leg and a ship that's faster than it looks.

powers.name: Broadside
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Every cannon on the ship fires at once.

tactics: Leads from the front. Offers parley and trades blows with the best of them.

name: Goggled Inventor
description: A soot-smeared, goggled inventor with a lab coat, a half-built machine and an enthusiastic, mildly dangerous plan.

powers.name: Gadget Gambit
powers.text: No damage. Pulls out an invention with a random effect: the GM rolls a d6 (1: it explodes for d6 damage; 6: it works perfectly).

tactics: Fights by throwing gadgets. Will try to explain the plan while being attacked.

name: Airship Pirate
description: A goggle-wearing, grapple-gun-swinging raider who boards airships from a patched balloon.
tactics: Boards from above with grappling hooks. Cuts the lines and flees if outnumbered.

name: Smog Baron
description: A top-hatted, soot-grey mill owner with a cane, a cough and a factory that belches smoke over a whole town.

powers.name: Smoke Screen
powers.text: No damage. Fills the area with thick smoke, giving everyone inside cover (disadvantage to ranged attacks) for the battle.

tactics: Hires thugs and enforcers. Offers a bribe or a dismissal. Never gets his own hands dirty.

name: Junk Scavenger
description: A patched-leather, goggle-wearing scrapper with a pushcart of junk and a keen eye for anything useful.
tactics: Flees if a fight goes badly. Trades for anything shiny.

name: Wasteland Raider
description: A spiked-armored, face-painted road thug on a patched-up motorbike with a crowbar and a grudge.
tactics: Rides in packs and swarms its targets. Loots the fallen and runs.

name: Wasteland Merchant
description: A bundled-up trader with a pack-mule, a cart of wares and a firm 'no refunds' policy.

powers.name: Patch Kit
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a player or ally for the price of 1 handful.

tactics: Avoids fights and bargains first. Sells anything for the right price.

name: Glow Husk
description: A bloated, sickly-green, once-human shambler that glows in the dark and groans for water.
tactics: Shambles in groups. Radiation poisons anyone who touches it.

name: Mutant Brute
description: A green-gray, ten-foot, muscle-bound mutant dragging a street sign and screaming for a fight.
tactics: Charges the nearest target. Easily distracted by shiny things and loud noises.

name: Wasteland Warlord
description: A scarred, skull-masked king of the wastes with a war-rig, a hundred raiders and a bad temper.

powers.name: War Rig Charge
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Drives a rig through the party.

tactics: Leads from a war-rig. Offers to let the party join or die.

name: Bottlecap Hermit
description: A bearded, jingly old hermit in a coat of sewn-on bottle caps who is absolutely certain they are currency.
tactics: Offers to trade a cap for anything. Cries if refused.

name: Back Alley Surgeon
description: A cheerful street doctor with six arms, all of them borrowed.

powers.name: Quick Patch
powers.text: Heals an ally for 2d6 health, or removes one disadvantage.

tactics: Patches up allies in the middle of a fight. Gets very invested in whoever has the best implants.

name: Tea Room Medium
description: A kindly widow who runs a seance on Thursdays and hosts something else on Fridays.

powers.name: Borrowed Voice
powers.text: No damage. The medium speaks as a dead ally and gives one enemy disadvantage to attack for a turn.

tactics: Offers biscuits and gossip to calm the room. Calls on the dead for help if guests get rude.

name: Grave Clerk
description: A thin clerk who stamps death notices and has never been wrong about a date.

powers.name: Final Notice
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target has disadvantage until the end of the next turn.

tactics: Reads the names of the group aloud and sets deadlines. Tries to finish the paperwork on whoever is hurt.

name: Fleet Admiral
description: A grim commander in a black-glass helmet who runs entire invasion fleets from a single bridge.

powers.name: Fire Order
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Orbital strike on the marked spot.

tactics: Stays on the bridge or a command shuttle. Calls in reinforcements each turn.

name: Apprentice Tinker
description: A soot-covered kid with oversized goggles and a wrench half their size.
tactics: Hides behind a half-built machine and throws spare parts.

name: Industrial Magnate
description: A monocled titan of industry who owns the mill, the rail, and most of the sky.

powers.name: Hired Muscle
powers.text: Attacks up to three enemies this turn with normal damage, through his bodyguards.

tactics: Never fights alone. Offers a bribe, then calls the guards.

name: Greenhorn Deputy
description: A freshly sworn deputy with a too-big badge and a trembling hand on their holster.
tactics: Shouts a lot. Shoots wild when startled.

name: Railroad Baron
description: A top-hatted mogul who bought the county, the sheriff, and the only water for fifty miles.

powers.name: Gunhand
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Calls in hired guns for cover.

tactics: Stands behind his train. Offers a fortune to anyone who walks away.

name: Syndicate Enforcer
description: A chrome-armored street boss with a hundred enemies and a hundred more on payroll.
tactics: Walks through the door and lets the crew work. Pulls his own iron only when threatened.

name: Starforged Squire
description: A teenage squire in glowing runic plate who is still learning to hold a laser-sword.
tactics: Charges the first enemy it sees. Flinches if its knight is hurt.

name: Astral Archmage
description: A robed sorcerer with a halo of orbiting moons who bends starlight into spells.

powers.name: Starfall
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Hits everyone in the zone at once.

tactics: Stays out of reach and casts from range. Tries to turn the players' own light against them.

name: Iron Crusade Lord
description: A towering warrior in ancient power armor who has never lost a battle and never stopped yelling about it.

powers.name: Heresy Cleave
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Armor and shields do not count.

tactics: Charges the leader of the group. Rallies lesser troops with a shout.

name: Outlaw King
description: A legendary bandit with a crown of rattlesnake rattles and a gang that numbers in the hundreds.

powers.name: Shootout
powers.text: Attacks up to three enemies this turn with normal damage.

tactics: Never fights alone. Sends his crew first and picks off the hurt.

name: Cult Inquisitor
description: A pale investigator with a ledger of confessions and a silver knife for the ones who lie.
tactics: Asks questions. Strikes when the answer is wrong.

name: Midnight Kingpin
description: A smiling crime boss who runs half the city and sold his shadow years ago.

powers.name: Cursed Bargain
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is cursed with disadvantage until the bargain is kept.

tactics: Sits at a long table with a dozen bodyguards. Offers a bargain with a price in blood.

name: Royal Marine Sergeant
description: A scarlet-coated sergeant who has seen every kind of boarding action and enjoyed most of them.
tactics: Shouts orders. Forms a firing line, then a bayonet charge.

name: Pirate King
description: A legendary captain with a hundred ships on his flag and the sea itself at his command.

powers.name: Broadside
powers.text: Attacks up to three enemies this turn with normal damage.

tactics: Boards last, after his crew has done the work. Offers a share for anyone who joins.

name: Brass Warlord
description: A general in a clanking exosuit who commands an army of mechanical troops.

powers.name: Rally the Clank
powers.text: Attacks up to three enemies this turn with normal damage.

tactics: Marches with a squad of clockwork soldiers. Orders them to focus on the weakest.

name: Vault Tyrant
description: A shriveled old ruler of a sealed vault, in a suit of pre-war armor and a head full of secrets.

powers.name: Overseer Command
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is pinned until it obeys.

tactics: Sits at the vault door with a dozen guards. Offers safety for service.

name: Rim Scrapper
description: A greasy teenage scavenger on an outer-rim moon with a patched flight jacket and a stolen blaster.

powers.name: Quick Shot
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Fires the stolen blaster at close range.

tactics: Fires from behind cover and bolts for the nearest ship.

name: Chimney Urchin
description: A soot-covered child who climbs up the factory chimneys with a bag of stolen parts.

powers.name: Soot Bomb
powers.text: Throws a bag of soot. One target is blinded until their next turn.

tactics: Hides in the flue and picks off items from afar.

name: Scrap Kid
description: A kid in a patched helmet with a rusty crossbow who scavenges the wasteland alone.

powers.name: Lucky Shot
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Fires a rusty bolt at a target in reach.

tactics: Hides on a roof and shoots from cover. Runs if hit.

name: Shadow Emperor
description: A cloaked tyrant who sits on a throne of black glass and rules a thousand worlds.

powers.name: Crushing Grip
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target cannot move until released.

powers.name: Storm of Lightning
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Hits everyone in the zone.

tactics: Orders his guards first. Strikes from the shadows once they fall.

name: Cyber-Samurai Champion
description: A chrome-plated blade master hired by a megacorp to cut down rivals in the open street.

powers.name: Flash Cut
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Strikes before anyone can react.

powers.name: Whirling Blades
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Hits everyone in reach.

tactics: Dances through the crowd. Targets the one with the best gear.

name: Bumbling Guardsman
description: A nervous recruit in oversized armor who is not sure which side he is supposed to be on.
tactics: Shoots at the sky. Surrenders when asked politely.

name: Nosy Landlady
description: A small, suspicious landlady with a rolling pin who always knows who is up in the attic.
tactics: Asks questions at the door. Hits anyone sneaking out without paying rent.

name: Tinkering Granny
description: A cheerful old woman who builds toasters out of scrap and shoos looters with a ladle.
tactics: Offers tea. Smacks players who touch her gadgets.

name: Field-Medic Droid
description: A battered, bright-white medical droid that follows the front line with a bag of stims.

powers.name: Stim Shot
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a friend in reach.

tactics: Heals the toughest friend first, then flees.

name: Frontier Doc
description: A rumpled traveling doctor with a battered black bag and a bottle of questionable tonic.

powers.name: Snake-Oil Tonic
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to any target in reach.

tactics: Patches up outlaws for a fee. Does not like to be shot.

name: Parish Exorcist
description: A tired priest with a wooden cross and a flask of holy water, cleaning up after the sins of the city.

powers.name: Blessing
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to any ally in earshot.

tactics: Chants and sprinkles holy water. Heals the possessed.

name: Ship's Surgeon
description: A sleep-deprived surgeon with a bone saw and a bottle of rum for the patient and the doctor.

powers.name: Rum & Stitches
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to any target in reach, for the price of 1 handful.

tactics: Hides in the cockpit during battle. Patches up the wounded in the sick bay.

name: Boilerhouse Mender
description: A grease-stained mender who patches both people and machines with the same brass toolkit.

powers.name: Brass Patch
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a construct, machine or ally.

tactics: Fixes the biggest machine first, then the most broken person.

name: Star Lantern Healer
description: A robed healer who carries a hanging lantern of captured starlight and mends wounds with its glow.

powers.name: Lantern Glow
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a friend in reach.

tactics: Stands behind the front line and keeps the warriors going.

name: Scrap Nurse
description: A stern wasteland nurse in a patched coat who trades stitches for bottle caps.

powers.name: Quick Stitch
powers.text: Heals 2d6 to a friend in reach.

tactics: Patches up anyone who pays. Gets mean if cheated.

name: Ship-Lord Regent
description: A cold, shaved-headed noble who commands a fleet from a throne of cables and glass.

powers.name: Command Presence
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target must obey or lose their next turn.

powers.name: Fleet Barrage
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Hits everyone in the zone.

tactics: Sits above the combat and issues orders. Uses a captured player as a hostage.

name: Hull-Breaker Grunt
description: A cheerful, overmuscled shipbreaker with an oversized hammer and no idea what a crisis looks like.
tactics: Smashes whatever is in front of him. Can be bribed with a snack.

name: Ironclad Quartermaster
description: A hardened quartermaster with a cutlass and a ledger who keeps every pirate on the ship in line.

powers.name: Boarding Party
powers.text: Attacks up to three enemies this turn with normal damage.

tactics: Barks orders. Never stands in front of the guns.

name: Ash-Road Preacher
description: A fiery wasteland preacher on a rusted motorcycle, leading a flock of pilgrims to a promised city.

powers.name: Flock's Fury
powers.text: Attacks up to three enemies this turn with normal damage.

tactics: Speeds into a group. Calls the flock to attack.

name: Smuggler Sparker
description: A scrappy mechanic in a cargo bay who works on stolen parts and nibbles on snacks.

powers.name: Tool Swap
powers.text: Gives a friend a gadget. They gain an advantage on their next roll.

tactics: Hides behind a crate. Swaps parts for favors.

name: Wasteland Gunslinger
description: A tall, scarred duelist in a duster with a rebuilt pre-war revolver and a code of honor.
tactics: Calls a duel at dawn. Honors the terms.

name: Cloud Giant Gourmand
description: A towering, friendly chef-giant who is delighted to add the party to tonight's menu.

powers.name: Soup Tsunami
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode. Scalds targets and makes the ground slippery.

powers.name: Pinch of Salt
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage. Throws a player across the room.

tactics: Wants guests, not enemies. Can be talked out of dinner by a better recipe.

name: Clockwork Ringmaster
description: A brass showman in a tall hat who runs the greatest show on gears.

powers.name: Spinning Spotlight
powers.text: No damage. One target must perform for the crowd and cannot attack next turn.

powers.name: Cannon Act
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode. Fires a clown out of the cannon.

tactics: Keeps the audience happy. Loses power when the crowd leaves.

name: Clockwork Emperor
description: A tyrant in a brass body who rules an empire by clock and cannot be stopped.

powers.name: By Decree
powers.text: No damage. Commands all minions to attack one target.

powers.name: Imperial Cannon
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

tactics: Sends minions first. Stopping his clock pauses him.

name: Cult Lawyer
description: A sharp-suited counselor whose contracts bind souls and whose objections cut deep.

powers.name: Binding Contract
powers.text: No damage. A target who agrees is bound and has disadvantage until they break the contract.

powers.name: Objection!
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

tactics: Stalls with paperwork while others close in. Offer a loophole to bypass him.

name: Scrap Queen
description: A wasteland boss who rules a junkyard fortress and rolls into battle on a throne of welded scrap.

powers.name: Rally the Pack
powers.text: No damage. Her minions all get advantage this turn.

powers.name: Scrap Cannon
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode.

tactics: Leads from the throne. Taking her down breaks the gang.

name: Drowned Boarding Party
description: A dripping crew of long-dead sailors that climbs over the rail in the fog.

powers.name: Dead Weight
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Hit targets are held by cold hands.

tactics: Climbs aboard from all sides. Sunlight or running aground drives them off.

name: Black Sail Captain
description: A skeletal captain whose ship sails without wind and whose curse follows any crew that sees it.

powers.name: Black Spot
powers.text: No damage. Marks one player; they have disadvantage until the spot is lifted.

powers.name: Broadside
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense.

tactics: Fights from the quarterdeck. His ship is bound to him.

name: Dread Inquisitor
description: A black-cloaked officer of the empire who interrogates with drones and doom.

powers.name: Mind Probe
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target reveals a secret.

powers.name: Interrogator Drones
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target.

tactics: Stays back with the drones. Cutting power to the drones makes him weaker.

name: Storm Giant King
description: A cloud-wreathed monarch in a thunder crown who judges all mortals as petitioners.

powers.name: Thunder Strike
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

powers.name: Storm Call
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Wets and shocks everything in the area.

tactics: Fights with dignity and demands a duel. Will accept tribute.

name: Shag Giant
description: A seven-foot furry co-pilot with a bandolier, a loud roar and a famous temper when a friend gets hurt.
tactics: Loyal to a friend first. Hurt his friend and he gets angry and fights harder.

name: Swamp Hermit Master
description: A tiny, ancient green hermit with big ears and a walking stick who fights like a hurricane.

powers.name: Force Push
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Knocks targets prone.

powers.name: Lift Anything
powers.text: No damage. Moves anything the size of a ship until it stops focusing.

tactics: Acts frail and confused until hit. Never fights when talk can win.

name: Star Knight
description: A robed warrior-monk with a laser sword, a calm voice and a strong code of honor.

powers.name: Blade Deflect
powers.text: No damage. Reflects one ranged attack back at the attacker.

tactics: Tries to talk first. Fights defensively and protects the weak.

name: Twin-Blade Zealot
description: A horned acrobat in black with a double-bladed laser staff and a grudge.

powers.name: Whirling Blades
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Hits every target in reach.

powers.name: Flip Strike
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Leaps past guards.

tactics: Cuts through guards to reach the strongest player first. Weak to ranged attacks.

name: Crimson Guard
description: A silent bodyguard in full red armor with a long force pike and a perfect record.

powers.name: Pike Sweep
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target. Hits every target in reach.

tactics: Always stands between the emperor and the party. Never talks and never retreats.

name: Cosmic Jester Emperor
description: A cackling emperor of the stars in a comet-tail cape who rules three galaxies by prank.

powers.name: Cosmic Prank
powers.text: No damage. Swaps the places of any two creatures or ships.

powers.name: Star Pie
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Covers the area in glitter.

powers.name: Laugh Track
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Hit targets cannot lie until they rest.

tactics: Treats the fight as a show and loves an audience. Tell a better joke to calm him down.

name: Megacorp CEO
description: A cybernetic executive in a golden suit who owns the city, the police and your debt.

powers.name: Hostile Takeover
powers.text: No damage. Converts one enemy of the CEO into a loyal employee until they rest.

powers.name: Security Override
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. Turrets and drones open fire.

powers.name: Golden Parachute
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 by cashing in a bonus.

tactics: Fights from a penthouse with drones and guards. Hit the stock price or expose a secret to crash his confidence.

name: Dead-Eye Legend
description: A near-mythical outlaw with a red bandana, twin pistols and a hundred tall tales, most of them true.

powers.name: Dead Eye
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

powers.name: Fan the Hammer
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Legend Grows
powers.text: No damage. Everyone who hears his name has disadvantage until they rest.

tactics: Wants a clean duel at high noon. Refusing to draw shames him into a rage.

name: Pirate Queen
description: The ruler of a hundred ships who commands the seas with a cutlass, a brace of pistols and a single look.

powers.name: Broadside Command
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Her fleet fires from the sea.

powers.name: Rally the Fleet
powers.text: No damage. Brings in a fresh pirate crew each turn.

powers.name: Pistol Duel
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

tactics: Fights from the deck and respects boldness. Win her over and she calls the fleet to your side.

name: Silver Ranger
description: A tall, cloaked space elf scout with a long rifle who watches from afar and vanishes into the wild.
tactics: Snipes from a hiding spot, then relocates. Fights with distance and patience.

name: Razor Raider
description: A spiked, black-armored dark elf pirate who raids on sky-skiffs and takes prisoners for sport.
tactics: Raids fast and grabs a victim. Leaves at the first hint of a real fight.

name: Pain Archon
description: A dark elf lord in a cape of flayed skin who runs a pain cult and loves a good audience.

powers.name: Poisoned Splinters
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

powers.name: Pain Feast
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6 by draining pain from a target.

tactics: Fights from a hovering throne with a retinue. Hit the retinue to take its power.

name: Mask Dancer
description: A grinning, masked space elf performer who dances through bullets and sings tragedies in a laser sword fight.

powers.name: Dazzle Dance
powers.text: No damage. A hit target loses its next turn watching the dance.

tactics: Moves through the fight like a stage act. Pays attention to the audience.

name: Mask Troupe Master
description: A masked, cloaked master of the dance who leads a troupe across the stars to act out a war.

powers.name: Final Act
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense. The dance sweeps through every target.

powers.name: Cast Shadow
powers.text: No damage. Becomes unseen until it attacks.

tactics: Directs the troupe like a play. Break the cast and the show falls apart.

name: Scrap Warboss
description: A huge green brute in a welded armor suit and a metal claw who leads the biggest mob in the sector.

powers.name: Waaagh!
powers.text: No damage. All of his mob gets advantage this turn.

powers.name: Claw Smash
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage.

tactics: Leads from the front and brags. The mob follows whoever hits hardest.

name: Greater Good Envoy
description: A tall, blue-skinned diplomat in white robes with two floating drones who wants to talk peace first.

powers.name: Rally to the Cause
powers.text: No damage. All allies within sight get advantage this turn.

tactics: Offers a treaty before shooting. Lose its drones and it falls apart.

name: Chapter Librarian
description: A blue-armored psychic warrior with a force staff who uses the warp as a weapon and a leash.

powers.name: Psychic Lance
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

powers.name: Mind Shield
powers.text: No damage. Blocks one psychic attack or power.

tactics: Stays behind the line and picks off psykers. Struggles when the warp resists.

name: Blood Zealot
description: A red-armored, horned berserker who bathes in blood and fights with two huge chainblades.

powers.name: Blood Rage
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage. Gains advantage on the next attack.

tactics: Charges the strongest enemy and never retreats. Pull it from the fray and it crumbles.

name: Inquisitor Lord
description: A black-coated, high-ranking judge with a hat, a seal and a retinue who can order planets purged.

powers.name: Purge Order
powers.text: No damage. Orders an allied squad to attack one target with advantage.

powers.name: Heretic's Doom
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

tactics: Questions first and burns later. Prove innocence and he becomes an ally.

name: Flame Sister
description: A warrior-nun in red and white armor who prays loudly, burns heretics, and does both with a smile.

powers.name: Holy Flame
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode. Burns terrain too.

tactics: Fights in a group and prays between shots. Faith keeps her going when hurt.

name: Golden Sentinel
description: A giant gold-armored bodyguard with a spear and a very old oath who has not left the palace in ten thousand years.

powers.name: Spear Sweep
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

powers.name: Oathkeeper
powers.text: No damage. Takes the next hit meant for an ally.

tactics: Never leaves its post and only attacks what comes close. A real oath bends its course.

name: Throne Warden Captain
description: The gold-armored commander of the palace guard in a red cloak, wielding a huge blade that sings.

powers.name: Last Oath
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense.

powers.name: Rally the Wardens
powers.text: No damage. Calls two Golden Sentinels to the fight.

powers.name: Whirling Blade
powers.text: Multi-target 3d6, one die per target, ignores defense.

tactics: Fights from the front and speaks little. Respects honorable duelists.

name: Hybrid Cultist
description: A four-armed, purple-skinned, half-human cultist with a mining tool and a secret faith in the star-child.
tactics: Hides in the crowd. Strike when the cult leader gives a signal.

name: Hearth Miner
description: A short, stocky, bearded asteroid miner in a mining suit with a pick, a laser drill and a stubborn streak.
tactics: Digs in and holds the line. Never leaves a mate behind.

name: Ancestor Hold Lord
description: A short, tough, armored lord of a mining clan with a huge beard, a hammer and a ledger of old grudges.

powers.name: Settle the Grudge
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Doubles on a creature that wronged it.

tactics: Remembers every insult. Pay a debt and it stands as an ally.
